name: Demo Server (built-in)
description: A tiny fake game server for testing Between end-to-end in seconds — no downloads. Opens a real TCP port, prints Minecraft-style logs, supports console commands (help, say, list, tps, crash, stop) and simulates player joins and crashes.

install.content:
This is the Between demo server.
Start it from the panel and try console commands: help, say hi, list, tps, crash, stop.

variables.label: Server port
variables.description: TCP port the demo server listens on.

notes: Perfect first server: instant install, instant start. Try the 'crash' command to see crash detection and auto-restart in action.
